name: Whispering Forest
summary: The Whispering Forest is a secluded, mountainous woodland nestled behind the steep cliffs west of Deathknell. Largely cut off from the rest of Tirisfal Glades, it harbors uncanny wildlife, a mysterious fairy circle, and deep-seated corruption sleeping far beneath the soil.

sections.title: The Hidden Glen
sections.body: Tucked away behind Northface Rock and Bandarion Keep, the Whispering Forest feels entirely alienated from the surrounding plague-touched kingdom. While it contains afflicted deer and roaming predators, it also features a tranquil lake and a strange ring of giant mushrooms, glowing with an uncanny energy beneath a hovering cloud of mist. The ghostly Knight of Mourning wanders the fairy circle, bound there by oath, amid a natural magic that seems to defy the Scourge-ruined land.

sections.title: The Shadow Beneath the Woods
sections.body: Despite its outward wonder, the forest is tainted by an ancient dread. Centuries ago, the high elves briefly attempted to settle in Tirisfal Glades before being driven away when the latent evil sleeping deep underground began driving them mad. Around the local lake, Vile Fin murlocs and the undead threshadon Blightsculler prowl the waters, while the ruined settlement of Shadowvale lies blighted by necromantic remnants. Even mad wanderers across Lordaeron mutter fearful warnings of the consuming darkness resting beneath Tirisfal's roots.

faq.q: Where is the Whispering Forest located?
aliases: how to get to whispering forest
faq.answer: The forest lies in the mountains of western Tirisfal Glades, positioned just west of Deathknell and south of Tyr's Fall. It is walled off by Northface Rock, the steep ridge upon which Bandarion Keep rests.

faq.q: What happens at the giant mushroom circle?
faq.answer: The ring of giant mushrooms glows with a strange energy beneath a hovering cloud of mist. The ghostly Knight of Mourning wanders the circle, bound there by an oath, but what the ring's magic truly is remains unknown.
The overlooking heights of Bandarion Keep are held by Tyr's Watch, an order of Forsaken paladins. Near the fairy circle itself, the spectral Knight of Mourning is bound by oath to wander the woods.

faq.q: Why did the high elves abandon this region long ago?
faq.answer: When the high elves originally landed on Lordaeron's shores, they attempted to build a settlement in Tirisfal. Within a few years, an unsettling presence buried deep underground began eroding their sanity, compelling them to abandon the glades and travel north.

Shadowvale is a ruined village situated southwest of the forest's lake. It is occupied by the Tarnished alongside mindless undead afflicted by a necromantic crystal fragment dating back to clashes involving the Undercity.

angles.text: The glowing faerie ring stands out as one of the few pulses of natural magic remaining within blighted Lordaeron.
Nestled just past Deathknell and overseen by Tyr's Watch at Bandarion Keep, the secluded woodland hides forgotten dangers that pose a silent threat right on the Undercity's doorstep.
